ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Add a short heading above the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.

SectionDescription.helper: Required. Briefly explain how these related offerings help visitors. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Explore related solutions that work well together.

CrossPromotions.label: Cross Promotions
CrossPromotions.helper: Add as many cross-promotion cards as needed. Every saved card is displayed.

Title.helper: Required. Use a short, recognizable name for the related offering. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.

Description.helper: Required. Use a phrase or short sentence instead of a long description. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

CardLink.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https web addresses. When provided, the whole card becomes a link.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note beneath the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Not sure where to start? Contact our team.
